label: Beneficiary bank changed account format
description: The beneficiary bank migrated to a new account-number format; old-format numbers are rejected.
default_fix: Convert the account number to the bank's new format and resend.

label: Client keyed wrong details
description: One-off data-entry error by the client (account number, IBAN, BIC or name typo).
default_fix: Ask the client for the correct details, repair and resend.

label: Arrived after bank cut-off
description: The payment reached the beneficiary bank after its same-day cut-off, so it credits the next business day.
default_fix: Confirm next-day credit to the client; no trace needed. Advise earlier submission.

label: Held at an intermediary bank
description: Funds are held or delayed at an intermediary/correspondent bank.
default_fix: Send a trace (MT199 / camt.027) to the intermediary and follow up.

label: Name must match registered legal name
description: The beneficiary bank does exact name matching; abbreviated company suffixes (Pvt Ltd) are rejected.
default_fix: Amend the beneficiary name to the full registered legal name and resend.

label: Known sanctions false positive
description: Screening hit on a beneficiary that Compliance has previously cleared as a false positive.
default_fix: Route to Compliance with the prior clearance reference. Never auto-release.

label: Potential sanctions match
description: New screening hit that has not been cleared before; needs full Compliance review.
default_fix: Escalate to Compliance for full review. Never auto-release.

label: Invoice number required
description: The beneficiary bank requires an invoice number in the remittance information for trade payments.
default_fix: Get the invoice number from the client and resubmit with it in the remittance info.

label: Regulatory purpose code missing
description: A regulatory purpose code or reporting field is required for this corridor and was missing.
default_fix: Get the purpose code from the client and resubmit.

label: Correspondent / routing changed
description: The beneficiary bank changed its correspondent bank; the payment went via the old route.
default_fix: Update standard settlement instructions and resend via the new correspondent.

label: Client system re-sent a file
description: A duplicate caused by the client's ERP/system re-sending a payment file (known recurring behaviour).
default_fix: Cancel the duplicate instruction and notify the client's IT team.

label: Possible duplicate - verify
description: Looks like a duplicate but may be intentional (e.g. two invoices with the same amount).
default_fix: Verify with the client before releasing or cancelling.

label: Our nostro account is short
description: Our own nostro account in that currency lacks funds (e.g. heavy month-end outflows).
default_fix: Ask Treasury to top up the nostro, then release the payment.

label: Client account lacks funds
description: The client's own debit account does not have enough balance.
default_fix: Hold the payment and ask the client to fund the account.

label: Beneficiary account closed
description: The beneficiary's account has been closed.
default_fix: Return funds and ask the client for the beneficiary's new account.
